name: Gustave (Nile Crocodile)
description: Only works if Nile Crocodile is in the party. Deals massive damage (160 BP, scales with the Nile Crocodile's attack stat) and causes the opponent to bleed.

name: Locust Swarm
description: Requires an Acrididae family creature in the party. Disables all berry item usage for the rest of the battle for both sides.

name: Flash Flood
description: Effect scales by Biome. Desert/Savanna: Clears hazards and sets Rain. Wetland/River: Applies Stun or Vulnerable. Mountain/Taiga: Triggers Mudslide (Speed -2 for grounded animals) or fails.

name: Wildfire
description: Requires Jungle, Forest, or Taiga biome. Instantly converts the biome into an Ashen Waste terrain for 3 turns (Burns non-Fire types, halves healing).
